object.attr: derived: tag, zero-width and direction-changing characters carry text that a person checking the transcript can't see (CF-M51, review Q15). Flagged, not stripped, so text an agent writes back stays as stored. Decided on 2026-11-10. The term Invisible character is shared with MELLON-VER-SRS-82.
object.description: If text that a tool returns holds an invisible character, the MCP server should name in the result each object or commit whose text holds one.
